steps.what: Open quantities of materials and equipment
Estimate materials, equipment, and labor from stored prices
Determine project feasibility from the estimate

tasks.design: Quantities of materials and equipment are opened from {PROJECT}. Materials, equipment, and labor are estimated from stored prices. A missing price stays blank. The civil engineer determines project feasibility from the estimate and signs the note. The total does not decide feasibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: The estimate was a side sheet of quantities times prices.
tasks.enabler_now: The quantities and the price rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The feasibility decision stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer judges whether the project can proceed.

ambition.what: A stored price total can be checked before feasibility is decided.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the feasibility decision. The total is ready before the engineer reads it.

reach.learn: Which price rows the total used.

evidence.claim: Stored quantities can be multiplied by stored prices. The civil engineer still determines project feasibility. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when quantities and prices are stored and ends when the engineer has signed the feasibility note or returned a blank price.
A quantity row has item id, quantity, and price, entered by the project lead. A blank price is not filled. Labor hours are a quantity the project lead entered.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often a price row is blank.
research_questions: Which feasibility notes were signed from a complete total, and which had a blank price?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The feasibility note and the stored price total

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a price is blank and the engineer builds the estimate by hand. High: the prices are stored and the engineer still determines feasibility. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and present the public reports

steps.what: Open environmental impact statements, deeds, topics, and property descriptions
Prepare public reports on proposals and the right of way

loop.input: Stored figure ids and fact ids for the proposal, the deed, the impact statement, or the property description.
loop.output: A draft of the public reports that cites only those ids.
loop.check: Each cited id is present in the file, and no figure is added.
loop.stop: Stop when a cited id is missing. The civil engineer writes that passage.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot write the public sentences, and a draft that invents an impact figure is not acceptable.

tasks.design: Environmental impact statements, deeds, topics, and property descriptions are opened from {DOCS}. A draft of the public reports on proposals and the right of way cites only stored figure ids and stops when an id is missing. The civil engineer signs the reports and presents them. Nothing public goes out before that signature.
tasks.previous_blocker: The public report was written from a folder of deeds and statements.
tasks.enabler_now: The source ids are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Signing and presenting the public reports stay with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer is responsible for what is said in public.

ambition.what: A public report can be signed before it is presented.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the presentation. The draft cites only stored ids.

reach.learn: Which figure ids the reports cite.

evidence.claim: A draft can cite stored figure ids for a public report. The civil engineer still signs and presents it. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

research_questions: Which public reports were signed and presented, and which stopped on a missing id?

tasks.short: Design the structures and cite the criteria

steps.what: Open energy efficient criteria for environmentally sound civil structures
Check the design note cites each criterion

tasks.design: Energy efficient criteria for environmentally sound civil structures are opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer designs the structures. A check confirms the design note cites each stored criterion id and adds none. The civil engineer signs the note. The screen does not design the structure and does not invent an energy result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The criteria were a list the engineer checked by hand at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: The criterion ids are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The design of the structure stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer chooses the structure and stands behind the note.

ambition.what: A design note can be signed only when each stored criterion is cited.

tasks.altitude: The week is still design. The criterion list is open before the engineer starts.

reach.learn: Which criterion ids the note cites.

evidence.claim: A stored criterion list can be checked against a design note. The civil engineer still designs the structures and signs the note. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when energy criteria are stored and ends when the engineer has signed the note or the citation check has failed.
A criterion row has criterion id and text, entered by the project lead. The check is the set of cited ids against the stored ids.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the design note omits a stored criterion.
research_questions: Which design notes were signed with every criterion cited, and which failed the check?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The design note and the criterion ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the note omits a criterion and the engineer rewrites it. High: the criteria are stored and the engineer still designs and signs. The range stays under the net.

tasks.short: Test the materials and judge strength

steps.what: Open the method for soils and materials
Test foundations, concrete, asphalt, and steel
Determine adequacy and strength from the test

tasks.design: The method for soils and materials is opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer tests foundations, concrete, asphalt, and steel, then determines adequacy and strength from the test. The record stores what the engineer entered. It does not invent a strength.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method was a sheet the engineer carried to the test.
tasks.enabler_now: The method file is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The test and the strength call stay with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer runs the test and reads the result.
tasks.altitude: The week is still testing. The method is open before the engineer starts.

reach.learn: Which method file the test followed.

evidence.claim: A stored test method can be opened. Testing and determining adequacy and strength stay with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a method file and a sample are ready and ends when the engineer has written the adequacy note or marked the test incomplete.
A method row has method id and material, entered by the project lead. Material is soils, foundations, concrete, asphalt, or steel. The strength is a value the engineer entered.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the sample cannot be tested by the stored method.
research_questions: Which tests were completed, and which were marked incomplete?

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the sample cannot be tested and the method file is unused. High: the method is open and the engineer still tests and judges strength. The range stays under the net.

role.altitude: The civil engineer still decides feasibility, presents public reports, designs structures, and tests materials. A stored total or a criterion list is open first.
reach: A reader sees a public report only after the engineer signs it.
The project file shows a design note only when each criterion id is cited.
skills_to_grow: Do not let a price total decide feasibility.
Do not present a report that cites a missing id.
Do not record a strength the test did not show.
role.ambitious_version: Stored prices, cited ids, and test methods are ready before the decision. The engineer still decides feasibility, signs the public report, designs the structure, and tests the material.
